what: omnimd-mlmd run: NVT molecular dynamics (CSVR, 300 K, tau 50 fs) of a HAP frame of the sealed test, 0.5 fs steps, 20,000 steps, a sample every 50 steps, the trained se_e2_a model of the evaluator benchmarks (hap-iter0-pre/ens4-f32-0) in float32 with tables (compress_min_distance 0.5); the engine prints the time of its steps, model loading not included. Beside it omnimd-native-gpu-eval --bench 3000 with --compress 0.5 in float32 on the same frame and model. Two builds of each, alternated in 5 rounds in one session, the least of each kept; the build before twice a round, so that `before_again` against `before` shows what the machine adds
affinity: Every process held to logical processors 2 to 15, the performance cores of the i9-14900K but the first (a Python wrapper sets the affinity of the script, and the programs it starts inherit it): run by the scheduler, the host side of a run lands on performance or efficiency cores, which differ by 1.5 to 2 times in the packing alone.

builds.after: omnimd-mlmd and omnimd-native-gpu-eval of this change (the single-pass packing)
